details.report: Repaired the outcome-contract root cause by replacing shared optional-field shapes with status-discriminated unions across public V2 receipts, runner results, and ledger evidence. Successful outcomes now require materialization evidence and exclude failure; failed outcomes require classification and preserve optional post-materialization evidence. Settlement now projects each branch directly, and the ledger rejects successful settlements lacking evidence. Added compile-time contract assertions and validator, assembly, ledger, runner, and production-lifecycle regressions. Regenerated tracked artifacts. Verification passed: focused tests, typecheck, isolated-HOME full suite (331 pass, 5 skipped), package/cold-install lifecycle, npm pack dry-run, and git diff check. Historical dockets were not modified; the dismissed historical-manifest finding was not adopted because immutable invocation receipts are outside this authorized class.

classesRepaired.name: Discriminated successful materialization outcomes
classesRepaired.searchScope: Public receipt contract, Reviewer agent runner outcomes, execution-ledger settlement evidence, settlement assembly, tracked production artifact, and all repository tests/usages of runtimeConstructionEvidence.
